name: Spicy Fried Cauliflower Rice with Flank Steak, Zucchini & Green Onion

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ medium head cauliflower
1 medium zucchini squash
½ small bunch green onions (scallions)
1 jalapeño pepper
1 (1 inch) piece ginger root

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the steak dry with paper towels, place on a cutting board, and slice crosswise into thin strips. Place in a small bowl, add soy sauce, and stir to coat.
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ lb flank steak
1 tbsp soy sauce

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add steak strips and cook, undisturbed, until browned, about 3 minutes. Turn and continue to cook until desired doneness, 1-2 minutes more. Remove to a plate. (Reserve skillet and cooking juices for later use.)

Meanwhile, using a clean cutting board, cut cauliflower head into quarters; using a box grater, hold the stem end of the cauliflower and coarsely grate. (Alternatively, transfer cauliflower to the bowl of a food processor; pulse until rice-like in consistency.) Place in a medium bowl.
Trim and coarsely grate zucchini. Using your hands, gently squeeze to remove excess water, then add to the bowl with the cauliflower.
Trim and cut green onions crosswise into 1-inch pieces. Add to the bowl.

Return the skillet (with cooking juices) to medium-high heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add cauliflower, zucchini, green onion, salt, and pepper; cook, stirring occasionally, until cauliflower is soft and starting to brown, 5-6 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tsp toasted sesame oil
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, quarter jalapeño pepper lengthwise; seed and remove ribs with a spoon to reduce spice level, then mince. Place in a clean small bowl. (Be careful with jalapeños; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Peel and mince ginger and garlic. Add both to the bowl with the jalapeño, along with soy sauce, and stir to combine.

When the cauliflower is done, return steak strips (with any accumulated juices) to the skillet. Add the jalapeño mixture and continue to cook, stirring frequently, until warmed through and fragrant, about 1 minute. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide fried cauliflower rice between plates or bowls. Enjoy!
